transports.problem: Returned to the client as the reason_code of an RFC 9457 Problem body under the declared http_status.
transports.claim-rejection: Returned inside ClaimBatchResult.rejections against one claim index. The batch operation itself answers 200, so http_status is null.
transports.appraisal: Recorded on the server appraisal or the ranking projection and read through the private notice path. It never appears on the wire, so http_status is null.
transports.notification: Recorded on a retracted inbox item as Notification.retraction_reason_code and read through listNotifications. It is not an RFC 9457 Problem body and answers no request, so http_status is null.
transports.local-channel: Refusals carried on the local IPC channel between a role process and the daemon. They never reach the network and never reach a participant surface; they are recorded locally and surfaced in diagnostics.

non_aggregate_authorities.vibeproof-v1: The wire protocol, not a mutable aggregate. A claim is validated and either accepted or rejected; it has no lifecycle to hold a state, so these codes answer for the protocol rather than for a row. Owned by docs/architecture/VIBEPROOF_V1_PROTOCOL.md.
non_aggregate_authorities.server-runtime: The request path itself, not a mutable aggregate. Malformed input, an invalid cursor, a rate limit or an internal fault belong to the runtime that answered the request, and none of them moves a row through a state. Owned by docs/architecture/API_EDGE_CONTRACT.md.
non_aggregate_authorities.local-channel-v1: The local control protocol in packages/schemas/local-control-v1.proto. It is a wire format between processes on one device, not a persisted aggregate, so it has no state machine and no persistence owner; its refusals still need stable identifiers so a diagnostic can name them.

operation_class_definitions.public: Operations whose security requirement is the empty list.
operation_class_definitions.native-bound: Authenticated operations where every security alternative requires deviceProof.
operation_class_definitions.mutating: Operations using POST, PUT, PATCH or DELETE.
operation_class_definitions.mutating-authenticated: The intersection of mutating and authenticated.
operation_class_definitions.collection: Operations declaring both the cursor and limit parameters.
operation_class_definitions.path-addressed: Operations declaring at least one path parameter.
